title: Liquid War
tagline: Command an army of liquid: flood the maze, swallow the other colours, run.
summary: Liquid War is a game of flowing armies. Every player's army is liquid with a colour, poured into a maze of walls. You steer a cursor; your fighters follow it and the nearest of them take the way around walls, so the crowd streams through the corridors towards the enemy.

Each drop that touches an enemy drop of another colour converts it. Stronger armies win a meeting, so the trick is to attack from several sides at once, to block a corridor with your own body and to keep your fighters close to the cursor.
This port follows Liquid War 5.6.6: the same mazes, textures, teams, rules, menus and music, playable against the computer, in hot seat and online for up to six players.
